newsitem.title: FRANCE: France holds suspect tied to IRA - justice sources.
newsitem.headline: France holds suspect tied to IRA - justice sources.

text.p: France's top anti-terrorism magistrate, Jean-Louis Bruguiere, has ordered a French suspect linked to the Irish Republican Army (IRA) to be held in custody, justice sources said on Thursday.
The sources said the man, named as Jean-Louis Backer, 46, was suspected of criminal conspiracy in connection with a terrorist enterprise.
He was suspected of giving shelter and supplying fake identity papers to an IRA guerrilla fighting to end British rule in Northern Ireland.
He was detained at his home in the northern Normandy region on Tuesday and placed under investigation, the sources said.
They added that French police had acted on the request of British authorities after Backer's identity card was found in a flat which police raided in London in July.
British police had arrested seven people after finding explosives and IRA leaflets in the flat.
